Definition: Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemariah = "kept by Jehovah"; 1) a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag; 2) a son of king Rehoboam of Judah; 3) an Israelite of the sons of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) an Israelite of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
